eventMetadata.context_description: No. 1 seed Duke Blue Devils entered their East Region Elite Eight clash against No. 2 seed Connecticut Huskies at Capital One Arena with a dominant 35-2 record and key reinforcements, as guard Caleb Foster returned from a right foot fracture to score 11 second-half points in their Sweet 16 comeback over St. John's, while forward Patrick Ngongba rejoined the rotation. UConn, aiming for a third straight Final Four, leaned on transfer center Tarris Reed Jr.'s 20-point outing versus Michigan State in the Sweet 16 and reinstalled guard Silas Demary Jr. in the starting lineup after his earlier injury absence. Both squads overcame postseason injury hurdles, with Duke's perimeter depth and UConn's frontcourt physicality fueling a trader consensus viewing the matchup as tightly contested amid March Madness upset potential.
